smeReview.role: independent Spring/JPA technology review, not education review
smeReview.instructions: Firstmate inbox 018 (four bounded technical corrections) and 020 (identity and accounting clarification).

findings.change: The objective, teaching, where-this-fits, task, hint, criteria, simulator output, printed alternatives, worked explanation, apply scenario, recap and GIFT pagination item now state Hibernate 7.4 behavior: on databases that support limits and offsets in subqueries the parents are paged in a subquery; elsewhere, notably Sybase ASE, Hibernate warns and applies the limit in memory, or fails when hibernate.query.fail_on_pagination_over_collection_fetch is set. Batch fetching or a two-step query is labeled the portable choice. The activity goal (paged listing with batch fetching) is unchanged and is now framed as the portable fix.
findings.sources: Verified live on 2026-11-06: the Hibernate ORM 7.4 HQL guide (Limits and offsets), the Hibernate ORM 7.4 User Guide (the fail-on-pagination setting, default false) and the Spring Boot 4.1.2 dependency coordinates (hibernate-core 7.4.13.Final); the last two were added to the page and its sources.json.

findings.change: The EAGER simulator output now shows a left join that initializes sessions before findById returns, and says Hibernate may use an immediate second select instead; the teaching and printed alternatives describe EAGER as timing (before the owner is returned, by a join or an immediate second select).

The null-foreign-key distractor feedback now says that without a remove cascade children are not removed automatically, the parent delete can fail on the foreign-key constraint, and a null key needs a nullable column and an application update.
